title_en: Life Respect Education (Suicide Prevention) for the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: The 2nd-semester 2026 Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education will be offered online through SNU eTL in two course periods, and all eligible new and transfer students must complete it. Students who do not complete it within a course period will not be given an additional opportunity.
applies_to: All new and transfer (신(편)입생) undergraduate and graduate students of the College of Engineering admitted in the 2016 academic year or later (2016학년도 이후).
steps: Log in to SNU eTL, go to the course list (강좌목록), and enrol in '[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육' ([College of Engineering] Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education).
Take the course within one of the course periods: Round 1 (24 August to 7 September 2026) or Round 2 (28 October to 27 November 2026). No additional enrolment is allowed after a course period ends.
Watch at least 80% of the video lectures.

Obtain the certificate of completion in eTL: 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right → Non-regular course enrolment (비정규 강좌 수강) → In progress/Finished (진행중/종료) → Issue certificate (이수증 발급). The certificate can be issued immediately after completion.
translation:
Title: Life Respect Education (Suicide Prevention) for the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Posted: 19 August 2026

The Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year will be conducted as follows. Eligible students are asked to complete the education.

A. Purpose: Through Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) education, to establish a safety net in which students can protect lives on the basis of a correct understanding of and knowledge about suicide.

B. Target students: All new and transfer (신(편)입생) undergraduate and graduate students of the College of Engineering admitted in the 2016 academic year or later.

C. How to take the course: Log in to SNU eTL → Course list (강좌목록) → enrol in and take '[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육' ([College of Engineering] Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education).

D. Course periods: (Round 1) Monday 24 August 2026 to Monday 7 September 2026 / (Round 2) Wednesday 28 October 2026 to Friday 27 November 2026.
※ If you do not complete the course within a course period, no exceptional additional enrolment will be permitted.

E. Certificate of completion
1) Watch at least 80% of the video lectures, then take the quiz.
2) eTL → 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right → Non-regular course enrolment (비정규 강좌 수강) → In progress/Finished (진행중/종료) → Issue certificate (이수증 발급).
3) Issuance: The certificate can be issued immediately upon completion.

Attachment (1 file): 2026년도 2학기 생명존중(자살예방)교육 계획.pdf (2026 2nd Semester Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education Plan, 70 KB). The content of this attachment was not read and is not included in this translation.
